title: The Space CRM next-best-action playbook actions are built but no screen calls them.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/crm/playbook-actions.ts:90 runSpacePlaybookAction and :164 dismissSpacePlaybook are referenced nowhere else (rg across app/components/lib, tests excluded). File header describes the Altitude 3 picker (ADR-382).

WHY IT MATTERS: Space owners never see a suggested next move on a contact; the circuit-breaker, run log and dismissal training signal collect nothing. A paid-tier CRM promise with no surface.

FIX DIRECTION: Mount the picker on the Space contact detail, or retire the actions and the ADR claim.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
